summary: Retested iteration_33 issue: fresh email login followed by Feed -> add-story-plus -> story-chooser-live now correctly shows the live-source-picker with camera/OBS options for streamers (wallowner), and clicking live-source-obs shows the live-obs-panel. Non-streamer (wallauthor) correctly skips the picker and goes straight into the LiveModal without live-source-picker. Fix verified end-to-end on fresh login (no reload).
test_credentials: wallowner@test.com / Test1234 (streamer, sees picker). wallauthor@test.com / Test1234 (no picker).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_33 bug (missing live-source-picker right after fresh email login) is fixed. api.me() is being fetched after loginEmail so can_go_live is populated before LiveModal mounts. Verified both streamer (owner -> picker + camera/obs + obs-panel) and non-streamer (author -> no picker) flows on fresh login without page reload.
rca of the issue: Login response did not include can_go_live; LiveModal mounted before user had updated capabilities, causing canObs=false and picker hidden. Fix in /app/src/lib/auth.tsx was to call api.me() right after loginEmail/registerEmail. Verified in this iteration.
